title: Lyn Buchanan met with an alien as a remote viewer
summary: Greg Bishop tells of Lyn Buchanan met with an alien as a remote viewer, about unspecified; told ca. 2016 at probably a military base, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Lynn Buchanan, who I've known for a long time, the Army remote viewer. Yeah. He told me like I don't know eight or nine years ago that he had met with an alien.

plain: A writer named Greg Bishop, speaking on a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels, says that Lyn Buchanan told him something striking around 2016. Buchanan is described as an Army remote viewer, meaning someone trained by the military to try to see distant places or hidden things with the mind alone. Bishop says Buchanan told him he had once met with an alien, probably at a military base, which would mean the Army's mind-spying work touched on contact with beings from elsewhere.
